component.name: Brain.fm for Linux
component.summary: Unofficial Brain.fm client with a daemon, CLI and MPRIS

description.p: An unofficial, unaffiliated Linux client for Brain.fm. A Brain.fm subscription is required; this application provides no music of its own.

Playback runs in a background daemon that exposes a documented D-Bus interface, so the desktop app, the command line, your status bar and anything you write yourself are all equal clients of the same service. The daemon also serves MPRIS, so media keys, lock screens and status bar modules work with no configuration.

ul.li: Mental state, activity, genre and neural-effect selection
Infinite sessions, countdown timers, or repeating intervals
MPRIS 2, with honest capabilities: Brain.fm sessions only move forward and cannot seek, so those controls are not offered
Sign in with email, or with Google, Apple or Facebook through your browser

description.p: Interface version 6: endless intervals, a readable timer mode, and new timer hooks to script against. The status stream now follows the daemon appearing and disappearing, and the Flatpak builds.
First release: the daemon and its D-Bus interface, the command line client, MPRIS, and native GTK4 and Qt6/Kirigami applications.
